headline: Poonawalla Fincorp submits compliance intimation to the exchange
hook: Routine regulatory disclosure from Poonawalla Fincorp
summary: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited has submitted a regulatory intimation to the stock exchanges under Regulations 6(1) and 7(1) of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. These regulations pertain to the compliance officer requirements and share transfer agent details. Such filings are procedural and routine governance updates for listed entities. Retail investors have no direct financial impact from this administrative filing.
